title: MPESB ADDET Result 2026 – Out
postName: MPESB ADDET 2026 – Combined / Departmental Examination Result
vacancyDetails: Result of MPESB ADDET 2026 examination for eligible candidates as per board notification
qualification: As per MPESB ADDET 2026 advertisement and post-wise rules
applicationFee: As per MPESB online fee structure
selectionProcess: Online / Written Examination → Result / Merit → Document Verification → Final Selection
documentsRequired: Application number, date of birth / password; educational and category certificates for DV
howToApply:
1. Visit https://esb.mp.gov.in
2. Open Result section
3. Select ADDET 2026 Result link
4. Login with application credentials or download score/merit PDF
5. Print result and note further schedule
shortDescription: MPESB ADDET 2026 Result is out. Check scorecard and merit updates at esb.mp.gov.in.
content:
Madhya Pradesh Employees Selection Board (MPESB) has declared the ADDET 2026 Result.

Candidates who appeared in the ADDET examination can check their result / scorecard on the official MPESB portal using application number and password, or by downloading the published merit list PDF.
